solution:
The correct answer is **"AUG is termination codon".** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• A codon is a **three-nucleotide sequence **that codes for the specific amino acid in a DNA or RNA.
 
• **George Gamow** suggested that genetic code should be made up of three nucleotides which code for 20 amino acids with four nitrogenous bases.
 
• There are 64 types of codon
